INSERT INTO dws_bizsummary_channel_daily ( ref_date, read_user_cnt, share_user, redirect_ori_page_count, redirect_ori_page_user, collection_count, collection_user, send_page_count, channel, account_id ) VALUES
( #{item.refDate}, #{item.readUserCnt}, #{item.shareUser}, #{item.redirectOriPageCount}, #{item.redirectOriPageUser}, #{item.collectionCount}, #{item.collectionUser}, #{item.sendPageCount}, #{item.channel}, #{item.accountId} )
mapper.select: SELECT channel_fixed AS channel, read_users AS readUser, concat(toString(round(read_users * 100.0 / total_read_users, 2)), '%') AS proportion FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN channel IN ('其它', '其他') THEN '其他' ELSE channel END AS channel_fixed, sum(read_user_cnt) AS read_users, sum(sum(read_user_cnt)) OVER () AS total_read_users FROM dws_bizsummary_channel_daily WHERE channel != '全部' and account_id = #{accountId} GROUP BY channel_fixed ) ORDER BY read_users DESC
SELECT sum(read_user_cnt) as readTotal, sum(share_user) as shareTotal FROM dws_bizsummary_channel_daily WHERE channel = '全部' and account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT CASE WHEN channel IN ('其它', '其他') THEN '其他' ELSE channel END AS channel_fixed, sum(read_user_cnt) AS read_users FROM dws_bizsummary_channel_daily WHERE channel != '全部' and account_id = #{accountId} GROUP BY channel_fixed ORDER BY read_users DESC
